common.emergencyDisclaimer: If you or someone you know is in immediate life-threatening danger, call 112 or visit the nearest emergency facility immediately.

hero.title: You do not have to carry this alone.
hero.subtitle: Free, confidential crisis guidance available 24 hours a day. Talk with an empathetic trained listener at whatever pace feels manageable.
hero.channel1Desc: Direct voice connection with an accredited crisis counselor. Safe, warm, and zero pressure to speak quickly.
hero.channel2Desc: Completely anonymous browser dialogue. No personal info needed, and messages leave zero footprint when closed.
hero.channel3Desc: Text quietly without needing audio. Ideal if you are near others and cannot speak aloud or prefer deliberate typing.

breathing.title: Need a moment to breathe first?
breathing.subtitle: Take thirty seconds to calm your nervous system. There is no urgency to interact until you feel steady.
breathing.gentleReminder: Take all the time you need. Our team remains available whenever you are ready.

faq.heading: Common thoughts before reaching out
faq.subheading: It is entirely normal to feel hesitant. Here is what to expect.
faq.q1Title: What if I do not know what to say?
faq.q1Desc: You do not need a structured story. You can begin with 'I feel overwhelmed' or even a single word. Our listeners are trained to help guide the pace calmly and without pressure.
faq.q2Desc: Yes. Your IP is scrubbed immediately, conversations are not recorded or sold, and you do not need to provide a real name, email address, or phone number.
faq.q3Title: What happens the moment we connect?
faq.q3Desc: A trained human listener will greet you warmly and ask how you are doing today. There are no mandatory surveys or clinical checkboxes. If you need quiet moments, they will stay present with you.

listeners.quote: "We listen without judgment, and we always move at your pace."
listeners.subtitle: In difficult moments, having someone listen with patience and empathy changes everything. Our listeners are rigorously trained humans, dedicated to being present when life feels heavy.
listeners.card1Desc: Comprehensive crisis intervention & psychological first-aid training.
listeners.card2Desc: Verified background and ethics certification for trauma care.
listeners.card3Desc: Gentle de-escalation with non-intrusive emotional support.

pathways.title: What brings you here today?
pathways.subtitle: Select what you are experiencing right now. We tailor our dialogue to fit what you need most.
pathways.p1Desc: Racing thoughts, tight chest sensations, sensory overload, or feelings of spiraling.
pathways.p2Desc: Feeling detached, without anyone who understands, or simply seeking a sincere voice.
pathways.p3Desc: Numbness, loss of energy, feeling ungrounded, or wondering if things will ever lighten.
pathways.p4Desc: Upcoming trial hearings, bail anxiety, relief compensation delays, or fear of retaliation.
pathways.p5Desc: Coping with the loss of a loved one, a life stage, security, or an unexpected trauma.
pathways.p6Desc: Threats from accused, village hostility, or urgent safety concerns.

privacy.title: Our strict privacy guarantee
privacy.subtitle: In crisis support, trust is paramount. We treat complete anonymity as an absolute fundamental right.
privacy.card1Desc: Every connection passes through an instantaneous scrubbing reverse proxy. We store zero geolocation data or device markers.
privacy.card2Desc: Once a chat or call ends, session memory is wiped permanently. Monitored records use unlinked pseudonyms.
privacy.card3Desc: Press the ESC key or tap Quick Exit at any time to immediately replace this site with a neutral weather forecast.

directory.title: Find in-person help near you
directory.subtitle: Looking for shelter, legal aid, walk-in mental health clinics, or crisis response centers? Search our confidential directory.
directory.placeholder: Enter district, state, or PIN code (e.g. Pune or 411001)
directory.subtext: Searches are processed anonymously and never recorded.
directory.item1Desc: Safe, non-punitive overnight beds and sanctuary
directory.item2Desc: Free legal counsel under SC/ST Protection Act

checkin.pageSubtitle: A calm, voluntary space to reflect on how you are feeling today.
checkin.consentNoticeText: This check-in is completely voluntary. Your answers help us understand your wellbeing and will never affect your compensation, relief claim, or court proceedings.
checkin.s1Explanation: Answering these questions is optional. They help us gauge how you are coping today.
checkin.q1Title: 1. Overall distress or emotional pressure today:
checkin.q2Title: 2. Sleep and physical rest over the past day:
checkin.q3Title: 3. Do you feel safe where you are right now?
checkin.q3SafetyWarning: Important: Answering 'No' indicates danger and will trigger immediate priority support.
checkin.q3Opt4: 4 — No, I am NOT safe / In danger right now
checkin.inputPlaceholder: Type how you are feeling or what happened today...
checkin.submitS1Hint: Submits only the 3 wellbeing questions above. Chat input below can be submitted separately.
checkin.systemWelcome: Hello. Thank you for connecting today. Please take your time, and share only what you feel comfortable sharing. We are here to support you.
checkin.criticalNotice: CRITICAL ALERT TRIGGERED: Your safety is our absolute top priority. Dedicated support coordinators have been alerted, and crisis helplines are available below immediately.
checkin.minorNotice: Notice: Support for young individuals is coordinated directly through dedicated child welfare services and Childline (1098).
checkin.s1RecordedDesc: Your wellbeing scale responses have been submitted for this check-in session. Subsequent messages will focus entirely on your conversation with Havenline.
checkin.needHumanAssistance: Need to speak with a human caseworker or helpline right now?

call.pageSubtitle: Interactive telephony interface demonstration with automated speech recognition and keypad triage.
call.bannerNotice: Simulated Voice Interface for Demonstration & Accessibility (Web Speech API). Not connected to actual telecom carrier.
call.press0Banner: Keypad Shortcut: Press '0' at any moment to connect directly to human crisis helplines.
call.transcriptPlaceholder: Your spoken words will appear here as you speak during an active call...
call.acousticDisclaimer: Note: Audio acoustic score weight is strictly pinned to 0.00 to prevent biometric, dialect, and acoustic bias.

helplines.title: Immediate 24/7 Crisis Helplines
helplines.sub: These numbers are toll-free, operational 24/7, and completely confidential.
helplines.nhaaDesc: 24/7 toll-free assistance for SC/ST protection and legal atrocity support.
helplines.telemanasDesc: 24/7 government psychological counseling and distress intervention.
helplines.kiranDesc: National helpline for mental wellbeing and crisis support.
helplines.emergencyDesc: All-in-one emergency service for immediate police, fire, or medical dispatch.

customModal.title: Self-Directed Check-in (Without Persona)
customModal.subtitle: Fill in your own details and case context. No pre-set persona required.
customModal.zeroPiiNotice: Strict Zero PII policy: Do not enter real names or contact details.
customModal.isMinorLabel: I am under 18 years of age (Minor)
customModal.isMinorDesc: Project SAHARA safeguards minors by diverting directly to an accredited human caseworker without automated scoring.
customModal.noCaseNotice: No active legal case reported. S3 case distress score will be 0 points, focusing analysis on emotional dialogue (S2) and self-report (S1).
customModal.firstTimeNotice: First-time check-in: Baseline will be established upon first contact.
customModal.consentCheckDesc: I voluntarily consent to confidential distress monitoring. Answers will never affect legal outcomes or compensation claims.
